symptom: Engine Git neutralizes every filter, so new workspaces of Git LFS repositories held pointer files and a direct commit stored LFS-tracked binaries whole in history.
rule: Principles 10 and 13: a hardening that disables a user's Git feature must say so where it matters; refuse a direct commit it would get wrong, and fetch LFS files through the user's own git-lfs in Setup, in Local and cloud.
